## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who hits it, and when? If it concerns
scientific output, describe the measurement need, not just the mechanism.

## Proposal

What you would like to happen. Note any impact on:

- scientific methodology (mask policy, selection, statistics) — these
  require doc updates and version bumps, see `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- the provenance schema or artifact contract
- infrastructure / cost

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you considered and why you prefer this one. "Do nothing" is
a valid alternative worth addressing.

## Additional context

Links, papers, prior art, sketches.
